title: SERVE
focus_line: Hope is the confident expectation in God's promises, anchored in Christ.

verse.text: God is not unjust; he will not forget your work and the love you have shown him as you have helped his people and continue to help them.

session.instruction: Be someone's hope today through service — give your time or your hands to meet a real need, and thank God for the chance to be used.

coaching_notes: I want to challenge you today to serve in a way that's outside your norm. Push yourself outside your comfort zone and there you'll find new spiritual growth.
